name: studylife-raycast
title: StudyLife
description: Control your StudyLife focus timer from Raycast and the menu bar.
author: lukislp

commands.name: connect
commands.title: Connect to StudyLife
commands.description: Browser login, stores this installation's API key

commands.name: disconnect
commands.title: Disconnect from StudyLife
commands.description: Forgets the local API key (revoke it on the server separately)

commands.name: timer-status
commands.title: Timer Status
commands.description: Current phase and countdown, with Start/Pause/Stop actions

commands.name: timer-status-menubar
commands.title: StudyLife Menu Bar
commands.description: Phase/countdown (or today's hours when idle) in the menu bar

commands.name: start-focus-timer
commands.title: Start Focus Timer
commands.description: Picks a course (open goals, or the full catalogue) and starts the shared focus timer

commands.name: course-goals
commands.title: Course Goals
commands.description: Read-only list of open course goals with their countdowns

commands.name: add-note
commands.title: Add Note
commands.description: Quick note capture, optionally attached to a course

preferences.name: instanceUrl
preferences.title: Instance URL
preferences.description: Base URL of your StudyLife instance, e.g. https://studylife.example.com. The API key itself is never stored here - it lives in Raycast's local storage, obtained via the Connect command.
